context: Ryosuke and Yumiko reflect on life on their anniversary evening.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 優子、今日で、結婚、二十二年だ。
lines.style: Soft opening, almost reverent. Warm and present. Pace slows on the anniversary milestone. Trailing gentle realization, not performance — the weight of the years made tender by saying it aloud.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: It really is. Time moves so fast.
lines.style: Quiet agreement, almost to herself. Warm but grounded. Eyes distant for a moment, held by the truth of it. Not wistful — just present with the fact.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 子供たち、立派に、育ったね。
lines.en: The kids grew up so well.
lines.style: Admiration in the voice now, genuine pride without boasting. Slight lift in the tone. Pause before 'grew up' — taking in the reality. Soft warmth throughout.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。さくら、リク、本当に、優しい子だ。
lines.en: Yes. Sakura and Riku are truly kind people.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Warm specificity — she's thinking of them individually. Slight softening on their names. Pride that lives quietly, not loudly.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.en: So many memories I couldn't count them all.
lines.style: Reflective, drawing inward. Soft wonder at the abundance. Slight smile audible. Pace unhurried — he's walking through them in his mind even as he speaks.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お父さん、覚えてる？初めての旅行。
lines.en: Do you remember our first trip?
lines.style: Gentle prompt, inviting him into the memory with her. Warm curiosity — she knows he remembers, but wants to share the remembering. Intimate, not testing.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.style: Specific and sure. The memory surfaces easily. Warmth of recognition. Voice settles into the detail like he can still see it. No nostalgia-performance — just presence with what was.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Slight laughter underneath. Warmth of the constraint — the limitation that made it memorable. Voice lightens here. Not sighing about the past, but delighted in the telling.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 懐かしい。あの時、若かった。
lines.en: I miss those days. We were so young then.
lines.style: Wistful but not mournful. Gentle acknowledgment of the distance. Warmth holds it — there's no regret, just the tender ache of time passed. Slight breath-catch on 'young.'

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Reassurance that's also affection. Steady warmth — not sentimental, but certain. Direct, as if handing him back something true. Slight smile at the edges of the words.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 家族、本当に、大切な存在だ。
lines.en: Family is truly the most important thing.
lines.style: Quiet conviction settling into the words. Philosophical but grounded — not abstract, lived. Warmth deepens. Slight pause before 'important' as if finding the word that finally fits.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: これからも、一緒に、歩こうね。
lines.en: Let's keep walking together, going forward.
lines.style: Gentle promise, not demand. Forward momentum in the voice but held close. Warmth at full depth. Slight reach toward him in the tone — offering continuation, not assuming it.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.en: Yes. All the way to the end.
lines.style: Simple agreement, profound commitment. Voice steady and sure. Warmth unwavering. No drama — just the quiet certainty of someone making a promise they mean to keep.
